name: Ayakashizoushi ~Oumagadoki no Yume~
original_name: あやかし草子～逢魔が時の夢～
source:
Main character is the successor of a shrine, but he does not believe in monsters, spirits etc. One day youkai begin to sing. Protagonist does not know how to handle youkai, but thanks to that inability he manages to handle them his way - by having intimacy with them. Luckily, all youkai have shape of little girls. Protagonist's revolution has begun!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是神社继承人，却不相信怪物、幽灵之类的存在。一天，妖怪开始歌唱。主人公不知道该如何应对妖怪，但正因如此，他设法用自己的方式处理它们——与妖怪亲密接触。幸运的是，所有妖怪都长着小女孩的模样。主人公的革命开始了！

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-march-2003-interlude.html]vndbreview[/url]]
